h: Agmond's End: kill these as you meet them

l.x: The Dustbelcher ogres camp just south of the valley; any of them drops scrap. Buzzards circle the plain to the east. The battered skeleton lies at the edge of the Stonevault trogg camp; Murdaloc, Agmond's killer, walks among the Bonesnappers. The Lesser Rock Elementals wander the Dustbowl west of Lotwil Veriatus. Careful: Dustbelcher Lords are level 44-45. They use Battle Shout and Demoralizing Shout, and below 50% health they call for help from allies within 15 yd. Seven of them stand about 750 yd south of Kargath.
The skeleton's next task, Murdaloc, waits until the later Terres ingrates guide at 43.
